label: 👊 Punch (0.5 beta)
description:
Twelve percussion FM engines on one machine. Raw, heavy and digital. Built on the Yamaha OPL2 with extended fixed FM ratios for modern sounds and alien harmonics.

[[video]]

KIK - Kick: the classic FM kick, three octaves of pitch drop into a sine body
TOM - Tom: tuned membrane, one octave of pitch drop
BNG - Bongo: high, short and tight
CNG - Conga: lower and rounder, with a short bend
DJB - Djembe: hand drum, pitch drop and FM body
TAI - Taiko: big low drum, deep pitch drop, FM body
TIM - Timpani: felt thud and a long membrane
MAR - Marimba: fundamental plus tuned overtone, mallet click
BLK - Woodblock: short, hard pitched click
GNG - Gong: low inharmonic metal, long FM decay
BUB - Bubble: pitch rises into the note
ZAP - Laser: four-octave pitch fall

SHAPE picks the engine
COLOR is the FM depth
SWEEP is the ratio, 1:4 to 15X
CONTOUR shapes the model's movement

[GATE] = on
holds the note for its length

[PUNCH] = on
MAR: vibrato
GNG: tremolo
Others: nothing
